about.title: About Skarpa Insurance Agency
text: Skarpa Insurance Agency is a family owned and operated, full lines insurance agency in Liberty County. We were founded in 1992 by Felix Skarpa and have continued to grow by providing our clients the best possible service and many options to meet their insurance needs. Current agency Principal, Steven Skarpa, is a lifelong area resident and graduate of the University of Houston.

We take pride in being an independent agency, and being able to tailor coverage to our client's needs. This is the primary reason we have made the commitment to be a Trusted Choice Independent Agency and adhere to the Pledge of Performance.
Connect with us to discover tailored insurance solutions that grow with you and your needs. Reach out now to secure your future!
